Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Westlake CAIQ sampling window and runtime evidence ask

Hi Naomi / Marissa,

Thanks again for taking this on. Our auditors at Westlake need a compact CAIQ runtime evidence package focusing on the controls around token runtime, KV cache locality, tenant isolation, and key rotation. Specific asks: 

- A manifest mapping CAIQ control IDs to artifacts (logs, extracts, narratives).
- A 7-day sample of runtime telemetry covering at-rest/ingress timestamps and KV cache hit ratios (we only need sampled lines).
- Proof of tenant boundary enforcement for dedicated pools (policy plus a short live-snapshot).
- A signed attestation for the runtime sampling cadence (DocuSign acceptable).

Target date for package delivery: Nov 10. We realize some artifacts require access gating; please advise on expected delivery timelines if Nov 10 is tight.

Also, can you confirm any PII-blinding or redaction steps we should expect? Auditors requested minimal redactions but want a clear redaction log if any.

Priya
Priya Sood
Senior IT Auditor
Westlake Bank

Subject: Re: Westlake CAIQ sampling window and runtime evidence ask

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the clear list. We can assemble an auditor-ready bundle. Proposed mutual action plan: 

1) Owners: Marissa will drive packaging and DocuSign attestation; Jonas will curate runtime traces and the KV cache sample; I will approve redaction decisions and the mapping.
2) Scope: We will produce a CAIQ crosswalk document mapping controls to artifacts and a manifest (evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx).
3) Sampling cadence: we propose a 7-day sample window starting 2027-10-24 through 2027-10-30. That window captures recent kernel/runtime releases and includes normal traffic patterns.
4) Artifacts to include: runtime-sample-snapshot.ndjson (traces), kvcache-sample-202710.log (sampled lines), policy PDFs for tenant isolation, and a short narrative for key-rotation cadence.
5) Delivery: internal review by 2027-11-01; shared to your Drive link and DocuSign out for attestation by 2027-11-02; final handoff by 2027-11-04 if no further auditor follow-ups.

Redaction: our standard approach is to hash any user identifiers and provide a redaction log (CSV). We will only redact fields that are marked PII in your questionnaire. Please flag any controls where you need raw identifiers.

I will attach the manifest draft and a sample log extract for your quick review.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
